title: HugeSMP
description: PvP-focused Lifesteal SMP with Custom Items, Hourly PvP Events, POIs, Base Raiding, and a Strong Player Economy
body:
**HugeSMP** is a Lifesteal server with an active PvP community and unique gameplay systems.


## Server features:
- Interactive Custom POIs
- Hourly PvP Events
- Custom PvP Items & Enchants
- Claimable Bases with Raiding
- Balanced Economy
- Voice Chat
- Bedrock Edition Support

## How to join?
Java IP: **hugesmp.fun**
Bedrock Port: **19132**

Discord Server: [discord.hugesmp.fun](https://discord.com/invite/bQ9YyWh4K8)
